interpretation.most_likely_causal_chain: Scheduled validator restarts stopped proof workers; retained replay and terminal census publication delayed worker restart. All four files contain zero completed epoch-634 proofs. Epoch-634 usage consequently fell sharply while operator and provider processes remained live. Swarm gap warnings predate this blackout and their exact scoped event counts have not increased since the prior 20:49 gate.
interpretation.next_run_fix_1: Make retained startup/census replay resumable with authenticated cut/plan/replica checkpoints and delta-tail revalidation; preserve every signed prefix and publication identity. Gate rolling-restart readiness on fresh proofs from both operators, not PID health. Deterministic restart fixture should prove bounded verified replay and proof resumption before the next full epoch; mismatch/changed prefix/replica failures must remain fail-closed.
interpretation.next_run_fix_2: Investigate Connect idle sequence-state recovery for receive idle 120s vs send idle 300s. The recurring expected-sequence-zero/queued-later-sequence pattern is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. Test a 121-299s idle interval, lost first ACK and route changes with exact-once delivery and full trail proof recovery; do not simply relax the final log gate.
interpretation.terminal_collection: Continue R46 untouched. Current owner observations, bindings, and monitor progress remain useful. V1 proof starvation harms evidence completeness and strict acceptance, but is not itself a requirement to block collection of the signed terminal and honest failed/partial result.
interpretation.validator1: Healthy means live supervised PID, not proof production. Increasing CPU/IO plus replay scratch descriptors demonstrate ongoing work; they do not prove a particular completion time or rule out an algorithmic performance problem. No deadlock or need for live repair established.
interpretation.validator2: Both operator proof streams resumed in epoch635; native steering still has retained EMA-jump failure and must not be called recovered merely because path proofs advance.

mutation_scope: Only new immutable qualification files. No process, fleet, live log, fault ledger, config or chain mutations.
